name: DCA Lamplight Lounge Kids' Grilled Chicken/Burger Sliders or Plain Elbow Pasta with Butter & Parmesan
brandOrRestaurant: Lamplight Lounge (Pixar Pier · Disney California Adventure)
whyItWorks: Even when Lamplight Lounge's adult menu leans spicy, any adult can order off the Kids' menu (or ask the kitchen for an adult portion): plain mini burger sliders on Hawaiian rolls, grilled chicken tenderloin, or elbow pasta with butter and Parmesan.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Ask your server for the Kids' Burger Slider (plain cheddar & bun) or Pasta with butter and grated Parmesan (hold the cheese sauce if lactose-sensitive).
watchOuts: Zero spice or roughage—a great fallback when dining with friends at Pixar Pier
